response.text: {"name":"Pod peskom","idea":"The homepage is a vertical cross-section of a Bizeljsko hillside: you start among the vine rows in the light, pass down through a band of golden quartz sand, and arrive in the dark cellar dug into it, where the wine has been stored since 1897.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#f1f4ef"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#e3eadf"},{"role":"text","hex":"#1e221c"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#4f5a4c"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#7a2331"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#f6efe6"},{"role":"band","hex":"#d29a3a"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#1e1a14"},{"role":"inverse","hex":"#1b1611"},{"role":"onInverse","hex":"#eadfcf"},{"role":"accent","hex":"#d29a3a"}],"pairing":"fraunces-nunito-sans","typeCharacter":"Fraunces at black weight (900), upright and never italic, sentence case, tight leading, soft and earthy like pressed sand. Nunito Sans at 18px regular carries running text, with semibold for list titles and the hours table.","composition":"Header (light tint #f1f4ef): the wordmark 'Vinarstvo Pinterič' in Fraunces 900 at left (cols 1–4), a short text nav at right (cols 8–12) and no button. Hero (light tint, 2 rows): the headline spans cols 1–7 at left-aligned display size, with the lead below in cols 1–6 and one burgundy #7a2331 rectangular button with square corners. Cols 8–12 hold a fine ink line drawing of a hillside cross-section: vine rows on the slope above a horizontal ground line, with long roots dropping below it toward the bottom edge of the section. The hero ends on a thin #1e221c rule across the full width, like the soil line. Sand band (#d29a3a, full width, short): a single ribbon of short words in Fraunces 900 #1e1a14 (Štiri generacije · 6 hektarjev · Klasična metoda · Klet v pesku), spaced along one line between two thin dark rules. Cellar story (inverse #1b1611, 2 rows): a huge '1897' in ochre #d29a3a Fraunces spans cols 1–6. At right, cols 8–12 hold the story heading and text in #eadfcf, naming the brothers Gregor and Tomaž. Below, an ochre line drawing of an arched cellar mouth cut into sand, with barrels inside, sits in cols 1–5. Offerings (inverse continues): heading in cols 1–6, then a 2×2 list across cols 1–12. Each item sits under a thin ochre top rule, with its title in Fraunces 28px #eadfcf and the description in Nunito #eadfcf. There are no icons and no cards. Visit (light tint #f1f4ef, 2 rows): hours as a seven-day week strip across cols 1–12, with the open weekend days filled in #e3eadf. Below it, the phone runs as a large Fraunces numeral in cols 1–6. Cols 7–12 hold the address with a simple schematic map: a line for Bizeljska cesta and a burgundy dot. Call (burgundy band #7a2331): the heading 'Rezervirajte degustacijo' in Fraunces #f6efe6 in cols 1–7 and the short text in cols 1–6. A single button in cols 9–12 has a #f6efe6 fill, #7a2331 text and square corners. Footer (inverse #1b1611): the email and address in small Nunito #eadfcf.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere. Below the numeral is an ochre line drawing of an arched cellar entrance dug into layered sand, with a few barrels inside, on the plain dark ground. 5) Still on #1b1611, an offerings section laid out as a 2×2 list.
